title: Assignment for a Term and Block Code
statement: Let $B$ be a switching block code of length $w$ and let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ variables. On a supported coordinate of $T$, use the sum modulo $2$ of the bit of $B$ at that coordinate’s literal position and the bit encoding the literal’s required sign, provided that the position is less than $w$; use zero otherwise. Coordinates outside the support of $T$ are also assigned zero.
hypotheses_covered: A switching block code of length $w$
